about: Web search settings for the discovery agent (Step 1) and the research agent (Steps 2-3). CGS can change these without touching code.

provider_options.mock: Synthetic internet in api/seed/mock_web.json. Invented companies, no API key, no cost. Use for demos and testing.
provider_options.tavily: Real web search through Tavily. Needs TAVILY_API_KEY in .env. Research then uses Aubrey's research pipeline on the real web.
provider_options.your_own: Add a class in api/search.py with a search() method and register it in PROVIDERS. See docs/SEARCH_INTEGRATION.md.

custom_queries_help: Leave empty to let the AI write 4 news queries from the research direction. Or list your own queries, for example ["manufacturer completes acquisition Ohio", "appoints Chief Digital Officer manufacturer"].
